objectives.description: Enumerate available fonts, set an available sans family on thmbox init and proof env
Render and inspect wrapped item text and spot-check other call sites
Record chosen font family in summary

approaches_tried.approach: Routed #item through Typst's native list() function instead of a manual block+dash, so it inherits the enclosing #items block's list styling (marker/indent/spacing)
approaches_tried.reason: Verified via pdftotext and a rendered page image (page 72): wrapped lines now hang-indent under the marker, matching a reference native-markup list's spacing exactly; all 9 real call sites (all nested inside #items[...]) inherit correctly with no call-site changes needed.

approaches_tried.approach: Chose 'Noto Sans' as the replacement sans font (plan's suggested default)
approaches_tried.reason: Noto Sans is a variable font; Typst warns 'variable fonts are not currently supported' for it, trading one warning for another. Switched to DejaVu Sans (a real static family with separate Regular/Bold/Oblique/BoldOblique files), which produces zero warnings.

approaches_tried.approach: Found a fifth style dict (example-style, for the 'example' ported environment) not covered by the initial 4-dict font-override pass
approaches_tried.reason: The compile still showed one residual 'unknown font family' warning after updating theorem-style/definition-style/axiom-style/remark-style; traced it to the ported-environments section (proposition/corollary/example/notation-env), where example-style was the one style dict missing the override. Added it.

approaches_tried.approach: Explanatory // comments in template.typ using backtick-quoted Typst-syntax fragments (e.g. `list()`, `.with(...)`, `#set list(...)`)
approaches_tried.reason: Broke Check 1 (7 new violations) -- the CONSTRAINTS section requires every backticked span in typst/ to resolve, comments included, and generic Typst-API syntax fragments are not Lean identifiers. Reworded the comments to avoid backticks entirely rather than whitelisting generic Typst syntax.

notes: Chosen font: DejaVu Sans, applied via a shared thmbox-sans-fonts constant threaded into all six style dicts (theorem-style, definition-style, axiom-style, remark-style, example-style) plus a direct .with(...) on the re-exported proof environment (which has no sans-fonts/title-fonts parameters of its own and never raised the warning, but is given the same treatment for consistency and future-proofing).

A concurrent build/edit hook appears to auto-regenerate typst/generated/status.typ on some trigger -- it freshened itself mid-phase (git diff showed it modified though this phase touched no Lean files), bringing sync-check Check 2 fully green for the first time since Phase 2. Included the freshened file in this phase's commit.
